Negotiable Instrument Act, 1881 - s. 138 - Complaint C under - Dishonpur of cheque - Territorial jurisdiction upon courts to entertain the complaint u/s. 138 where cheque presented for collection - Held: Presentation of a cheque for collection on the drawee bank or from a place of the choice of the complainant would not by themselves D confer jurisdiction upon the Courts where cheque is presented for collection or the default notice issued demanding payment from the drawer of the cheque.
